top_signals.title: Uganda Shilling Slumps to Two-Year Low as FX Demand Soars
top_signals.summary: Uganda’s shilling slumped to a two-year low against the dollar, weighed down by a surge in demand for foreign-exchange in key economic sectors including energy, manufacturing and telecommunications.

top_signals.title: DOJ charges Robinhood former engineers with front-running crypto listings on Hyperliquid
top_signals.summary: According to prosecutors, the two took positions in tokens ahead of Robinhood’s public listing announcements between 2025 and 2026.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.

top_signals.summary: The pair plan to hold consultations on a wide range of topics, including the South Korean-U.S. relationship and Korean Peninsula issues.
